text:
Biostatistics Research Intern (Summer)

About the role
Join a clinical research biostatistics group supporting cardiovascular and oncology studies.

Responsibilities
- Clean and analyze clinical trial and registry data in R
- Fit regression, survival analysis and mixed models and report results
- Build reproducible analysis pipelines with Git
- Help draft statistical sections of manuscripts

Required qualifications
- Pursuing a B.S. in Statistics, Biostatistics, Mathematics, Biomedical Engineering or a related field, graduating between May 2027 and December 2030
- Coursework or research experience in statistics
- Proficiency in R
- Experience with regression modeling

Preferred qualifications
- Experience with survival analysis or clinical trial design
- Familiarity with Python or SAS
- Experience with Shiny or data visualization
- Peer-reviewed publications or scientific writing

Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States.
